subject.title: feat(memory-core): optional cross-encoder rerank stage for memory search

question: Should OpenClaw accept this MemoryRerankProvider plugin SDK API, memoryRerankProviders manifest contract, exclusive single-slot behavior, and builtin-only scope before this PR is rebased and merged?
rationale: This PR creates a new public plugin contract and manifest surface; automation can review implementation details but cannot choose the long-term SDK/product boundary for maintainers.

options.title: Approve This Seam After Rebase
options.body: Accept the API shape, require the conflict resolution to preserve current-main abort handling, and merge after focused memory-core/plugin-contract validation passes.

options.title: Request A Narrower Contract
options.body: Keep the PR open but ask for revisions to the manifest gate, provider selection model, qmd scope, or SDK entrypoint before merge.

options.title: Pause Behind The RFC
options.body: Leave the implementation parked until the RFC decision settles or a competing reranker direction is selected.

recommendation.title: Approve This Seam After Rebase
recommendation.body: Accept the API shape, require the conflict resolution to preserve current-main abort handling, and merge after focused memory-core/plugin-contract validation passes.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is primarily a public plugin SDK and manifest-contract direction decision, and steipete has the strongest recent history on those boundaries.
